name: Tanabe Kento
source:
Miho's Boyfriend
A third-year student in the School of Economics.
He is set to work at the bank where his father serves as an executive.
He is Miho's childhood friend and the same age as her.
Just as he was worrying, “Am I only thinking about my own pleasure and failing to satisfy Miho, my girlfriend?” he met Naohiro and confided in him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01006023.html/]dlsite[/url]]
